features.title: Feito como um fight camp.
features.sub: Missões diárias, plano de 30 dias, sequências e XP fazem você voltar ao saco.
features.missionBody: One focused session a day, picked for your level.
features.drillsBody: Jab Builder, Cross Control, 1-2 Combo, Speed Hands, and more.
features.leagueBody: Climb your city, your friends, or the world. Resets every week.
features.cardBody: Your stance, strengths, and what to work on next.

faq.title: Perguntas
faq.q1: Do I need gloves, pads or a bag?
faq.a1: No. Your phone and some floor space are enough. Gloves and a bag help, but they're optional.
faq.q2: I've never boxed. Is this for me?
faq.a2: Yes. You start with stance and the jab, and the coach adds new skills as you level up.
faq.q3: How does it know what I threw?
faq.a3: Pad Cam uses your phone's front camera to track your movement and tell a jab from a cross as you throw it.
faq.q4: Which phones does it work on?

privacy.title: Website privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy covers boxingai.app, our link pages (/ig, /tt, /links and /go/…) and the contact form.
privacy.appNote: Using the app? The BoxingAI app privacy policy covers the app itself. Buying merch? Shopify processes your order under the store's privacy policy and Shopify's own privacy policy.
privacy.whoBody: BoxingAI is operated by {entity} (“we”, “us”), {address}. We decide how the information described here is used.
privacy.noSell: We don't sell your personal information, and we don't use it for ad targeting.
privacy.visitBody: Our host sees the pages you request, the site that sent you, your device and browser type, and your IP address when it delivers the site. It keeps short-lived server logs for security and debugging.
privacy.cookiesBody: The site sets only essential cookies. It doesn't use analytics cookies by default. Cookie names: bai_lang (language, 1 year), bai_consent (cookie choice, 180 days), bai_cr (region cookie choice flag, 24 hours).
privacy.rightsBody: Depending on where you live, you can ask to access, correct, delete or get a copy of your personal information. Email {email}.

terms.title: Website terms
terms.whichBody: The BoxingAI app has its own terms. Shop orders are governed by the store's Terms of service, Refund policy and Shipping policy. These terms cover boxingai.app, link pages and the contact form.
terms.agreeBody: These terms are a binding agreement between you and {entity}. By using the Website you accept these terms and our website privacy policy.
terms.useBody: You agree not to scrape or redistribute the Website in bulk, send automated traffic to inflate clicks, bypass rate limits or bot checks, probe or disrupt systems, or use the Website unlawfully.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Website or shop? Use the contact form or email {email}. We'll get back to you, usually within two business days.
support.subsBody: BoxingAI Pro is billed by Apple or Google. Cancel in your device subscription settings. Deleting the app doesn't cancel a subscription.
support.padBody: Prop your phone up, hands-free, so the front camera can see you, in good light with room to move. If rounds don't count, check camera permission.
support.crewBody: Crew codes are 6 characters. Open League → Friends in the app and enter the code.
support.deleteBody: In the app: Settings → Delete account. Or email {email} from the address you sign in with.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions about a merch order, a return or a product? Send us a message and we'll reply by email, usually within two business days. You can also email {email}.
